text:
marta: Morning handoff — quick capacity heads-up. pool-giraffe is at ~78% GPU util (12/16 GPUs in use), avg token/sec spiked 30% in the last hour. filling a few dedicated slots for scheduled evals.

devon: noted. Any expected customer ramp?

marta: yep, a couple of queued batch jobs from internal eval + one customer A/B test (acme-payments) that starts at 09:00 PT with steady throughput. We should watch burst limits — current burst remaining for giraffe is 18% of daily allowance.

li: @marta can you paste the short query for pool metrics? I'll add an alert rule if it crosses 85%.

marta: sure — run: 
```
# quick prometheus query
avg_over_time(gpu_utilization_percent{pool="pool-giraffe"}[5m])
```
if it goes >85 for 5m we should page ops-sre.

arjun: I can cover the 09:00–11:00 PT window if anyone wants to swap the rest of morning. Currently oncall schedule shows @sam until 10:30.

sam: I can do an early handoff at 10:00 if arjun takes 09:00–11:00. No planned deploys from my side.

marta: that'd be great. @arjun please add the swap to the handoff doc. Small FYI: pool-lark has lower headroom (2 GPUs free) and a slow leak in queued KV-cache usage — not urgent but might cause slight latency bump for long-chat sessions.

devon: thanks for flagging. I'll preemptively raise cache eviction thresholds for lark to avoid tail latency. patch looks like:
```yaml
service: inference-lark
cache:
  kv_max_entries: 120000
  eviction_policy: lru
```
I'll deploy in canary to one node first.

opsbot: [alert] scheduled-eval-job (team: research) queued 3 large jobs in pool-giraffe at 08:42 — estimated extra GPU-minutes: 540.

marta: opsbot FYI — those are the evals I mentioned. They should finish by ~10:15.

li: added alert rule: "giraffe_gpu_headroom_low" — fires when free_gpus < 3 for >4m. Escalation: devon -> oncall-sre.

arjun: I'll monitor the canary and kv changes. If we hit >90% util on giraffe, we should consider enabling capacity-burst policy for the account tier (tier: enterprise). Is that doable without infra approval?

marta: yes, we can enable soft-burst for enterprise customers automatically up to 2 extra GPUs per tenant. I'll toggle it if we hit 92% sustained.

sam: quick note for handoff doc: add explicit check list: prometheus query, queue length, opsbot alert check, active canary deploys. Saves time for next oncall.

marta: good call. I'll update handoff doc and ping the oncall channel when I flip soft-burst (if needed).

devon: one more — watching quota API rate limits: quota service returned 429 spikes for 3 minutes at 08:30 (rate: 420r/min). If that recurs when bursting, we might see failed allocations. I'll add a short-term retry backoff client patch.

li: noted. I'll add a dashboard tile for quota 429s.

marta: roundup — arjun covers 09:00–11:00, sam takes 10:00–end of morning, watch pool-giraffe for >85% (alert set), preemptive KV eviction tweak on lark, devon to roll retry patch for quota 429, opsbot queued evals finish ~10:15. Ping in thread if you manually trigger burst. :thumbsup:
